CONSTANT.label: Constant
CONSTANT.hint: Only users change it. Workflows read it.

MUTABLE.label: Mutable
MUTABLE.hint: Its owner workflow changes it during runs. Other workflows read it.

SCRIPT.label: Script
SCRIPT.hint: A shared function that returns a value each time it is called.

list.title: Global Variables

kind.label: Kind
kind.hint: The kind can't be changed after the variable is created.

errors.pattern: Use 1 to 64 letters, digits or _, starting with a letter.
errors.taken: A global variable with this name already exists.

secret.label: Secret
secret.hint: A secret value is never shown again after saving and is masked in logs.

value.label: Value
value.hint: Text, a number, true or false, a JSON list or a JSON map.
value.savedAs: Saved as {{type}}. Wrap numbers or true/false in quotes to keep them as text.
value.secretHint: Enter the secret value. It can't be shown again after saving.
value.secretKeptHint: Leave empty to keep the stored value, or enter a new one to replace it.

errors.tooLarge: The value is larger than 64 KB.

scope.label: Visibility
scope.hint: Which workflows may use this variable. Connectors can only use variables visible to all workflows.

errors.noTarget: Choose at least one category or workflow.

create.subheader: Define a value once and use it in any workflow, connector or notification.

update.subheader: Changes apply to runs that start after saving. Runs already going keep the old value.

general.subheader: Choose the kind and name the variable.

value.subheader: Set the value workflows will read.

visibility.subheader: Choose which workflows may use the variable.

save.failed: The global variable could not be saved.
save.kindNotEditableYet: Variables of this kind can't be edited here yet.
save.noEditPermission: You may not edit this global variable.
